decision.observation: The farmer is awake inside the farmhouse at 7:10 a.m. on Thursday, with full energy and the exit at the bottom-left.
decision.hypothesis: Moving down-left will exit the farmhouse so the farmer can travel to Pelican Town and take a southern route toward Willy's beach.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, go east through the bus stop into Pelican Town, then turn south rather than continuing to the eastern riverbank. Passing out costs money.
